study.notes: 2009 conference abstract: prespecified exploratory adipokine addendum to the EUREXA study (exenatide vs glimepiride added to metformin, open label), 33 overweight T2D patients analysed (15 exenatide, 18 glimepiride) at 9 months (39 weeks) with LS mean changes [SEM] by ANCOVA, LOCF; distinct analysis set from the EUREXA main trial rows already in the master (trial_id EUREXA); exenatide dose not stated in the abstract (0.01 mg, 10 ug twice daily, entered as the EUREXA regimen, to confirm); pct_weight_change -5.44 computed at reconciliation as 100 x -5.26 / 96.7 (LS mean weight loss 5.26 kg [1.03] and baseline weight 96.7 kg in the exenatide group, both in the abstract), not placebo corrected; adiponectin and leptin reported as medians with IQR (adiponectin p=0.975, leptin p=0.004 between groups) and recorded in notes only; PAI-1 and fibrinogen outside the inventory; sponsor Eli Lilly and Amylin (EUREXA, industry); extracted by the session (S), 2026-10-16

rows.notes: LS mean change from baseline to endpoint [SEM] in percentage points, p=0.796 between groups; baseline means 7.5 (SD 0.55) and 7.6 (SD 0.72) percent

LS mean change [SEM] in ng/l, increases in both arms (exenatide p=0.016, glimepiride p=0.003 vs baseline); endpoint means 9.2 (SD 2.21) and 9.9 (SD 1.98) ng/l; baseline means not given (endpoint minus change would be arithmetic, not done)

json.design: randomised open label active comparator substudy (addendum) of EUREXA, 9 months, 33 analysed

rob.justification: D1 low: randomised within EUREXA, stratified by BMI; D2 some concerns: open label; D3 some concerns: 35 entered, 33 analysed, LOCF; D4 low: central laboratory; D5 some concerns: exploratory addendum with predefined comparisons but no registration of the adipokine outcomes in the abstract

doubts: the group also holds the DURATION-2 abstract (hsCRP, BNP, adiponectin improved with exenatide once weekly without numbers; companion full paper Bergenstal 2010 Lancet by the title) and a 2009 liraglutide meta analysis abstract (not a trial)
exenatide dose assumed from the EUREXA regimen
